courses.title: Web Security: OAuth and OpenID Connect
courses.why: Tokens, scopes, the OAuth flows and OpenID Connect by Keith Casey: the identity half of this path, which comes up in every enterprise interview.

courses.title: Learning the OWASP Top 10 (2025 Version)
courses.why: The 2025 OWASP Top 10 with real breach examples and prevention. Longer than 3 hours, but it is the current list, released this year.

courses.title: The OWASP API 2023 Top 10: An Overview
courses.why: A 42-minute tour of the API-specific risks (broken object level authorisation and the rest) that backend interviews ask about.

portals.name: PortSwigger Web Security Academy: learning paths
portals.what: Free, structured paths through web vulnerabilities, from the makers of Burp Suite.

portals.name: PortSwigger Web Security Academy: all labs
portals.what: Hundreds of free hands-on labs (XSS, SQL injection, SSRF, JWT, OAuth) to exploit and then explain the fix.

portals.name: OWASP Juice Shop
portals.what: A deliberately insecure web app you run locally and attack, covering the OWASP Top 10.

portals.name: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series
portals.what: Concise defensive guidance per topic (JWT, OAuth, session management, input validation) to check your answers.

portals.name: OAuth 2.0 Playground (oauth.com)
portals.what: Step through the authorization code, PKCE and OpenID Connect flows against a real server and see every request.

assessments.name: Developing Secure Software (LFD121)
assessments.format: Self-paced online course (16–20 hours of material) with labs, quizzes and a final exam
assessments.credential: Linux Foundation digital badge and certificate of completion
assessments.why: The best free credential for a developer (not a security specialist): secure design, common vulnerabilities and supply-chain security.

assessments.name: Certified in Cybersecurity (CC)
assessments.cost: About $199 exam fee plus a $50 annual maintenance fee (the free One Million Certified offer closed to new candidates on 20 May 2026; check isc2.org for the current price)
assessments.format: Proctored multiple-choice exam, entry level, no work experience required
assessments.credential: ISC2 certification with a verifiable digital badge
assessments.why: A recognised name on a profile; broad security fundamentals rather than development-specific.

assessments.name: Burp Suite Certified Practitioner (BSCP)
assessments.cost: About $99 for the exam, plus an active Burp Suite Professional licence
assessments.format: 4-hour hands-on practical exam: find and exploit vulnerabilities in web apps
assessments.credential: Digital certificate with a unique ID, valid for five years
assessments.why: The most respected hands-on web-security credential here; take it after working through the Web Security Academy labs.
